thread:
shreya: Quick note from model onboarding: ropex-30k-int4v2 shows reproducible divergence vs fp16 after ~16.4k tokens during streaming + prefix prefill. Happens across CPU/GPU runners.

kai: can you share a tiny repro and observed diff?

shreya: repro steps:
```
# local repro
python ci/repro_longstream.py --model ropex-30k-int4v2 --prompt-file tests/long_prompts/meeting_notes.txt --stream-size 1024 --seed 7 --repeat 1

# observed sample diff (truncated):
# fp16: "...we'll sync up after the Q3 release to finalize specs."
# int4v2: "...we'll sync up after the Q3 release,, to finalize specs."
# note double-comma insertion and occasional accenty chars on repeated runs
```

jules: interesting. did you run the kv diff tool? any checksum deltas?

shreya: yes. ran `bin/kv-diff --model ropex-30k-int4v2 --session 20260322-a`
output:
```
kv mismatch at global_tok_idx=16384 shard=1 layer=21
fp16_kv_sha256=3f8b1c9a7e9a12b4c5d6e7f89a0b1c2d3e4f5a6b7c8d9e0f1a2b3c4d5e6f7a8
int4v2_kv_sha256=3f8b1c9a7e9a12b4c5d6e7f89a0b1c2d3e4f5a6b7c8d9e0f1a2b3c4d5e6f7b0
```

kai: off-by-128? last nibble difference looks like a single-word shift. ropex variants pack rotational tables differently. Could be anchor interpolation rounding when we quantize the sin/cos table into int4 scale buckets. Also check packed-stride alignment for memcpy across shards.

sam_ml: try these quick toggles to isolate runtime vs compile:
- run with env KVCACHE_PAD=64 and KVCACHE_PAD=128
- set ROPE_SCALE_MODE=dynamic vs ROPE_SCALE_MODE=frozen
- run with CPU fallback using --force-cpu-kv to see if mismatch is GPU memcpy related

shreya: starting with KVCACHE_PAD variants now. running 3 runs (pad=0,64,128) against the same prompt. will paste checksums.

jules: low-effort check: also try running `--rot-table-mode=fullfp` if available (forces unquantized rot table) — if that removes the delta, we know quant pipeline is culprit.

eng-ci-bot: created ticket ENG-7901: "ropex-30k-int4v2: KV checksum delta at 16384 boundary (stream+prefill)" assigned to @eng-ml and @eng-runtime. CI job queued: ropex-onboard/kv-diff/16384.

shreya: results so far:
- pad=0 => mismatch at 16384 (same sha difference)
- pad=64 => mismatch moves to 16384 but sha changes differently
- pad=128 => no mismatch detected up to 28672 in this run (wut)

kai: very telling. padding changing the symptom suggests a layout/stride rounding bug that only happens when data crosses a GPU page/word boundary. packing + quant rounding could produce different carries when alignment differs.

sam_ml: can you repro with ROPE_SCALE_MODE=dynamic and `--rot-table-mode=fullfp`? if fullfp fixes it, we need to change quant pipeline for rot tables or add a runtime remap to avoid packed misalignment.

shreya: queued a run with `ROPE_SCALE_MODE=dynamic ROT_TABLE_MODE=fullfp KVCACHE_PAD=0`. will post outcome but going to open a small PR to add an assert in kv-append that checks token->slot mapping at append time. safer to fail loudly.

jules: good plan. also add a microbench to exercise streaming chunk sizes (256/512/1024) on int4v2 to see if chunking interacts with packing. would be great to get a minimal C repro of the memcpy path (gpu->kv) if possible.

shreya: ack. i'll do the chunk sweep after these runs. tagging @eng-runtime for memcpy/packing review. :eyes:

eng-ci-bot: ropex-onboard/kv-diff/16384 completed; logs attached to ENG-7901.

shreya: for the ticket i've attached the raw dumps and will link the failing run. next steps: (1) reproducer in C for memcpy/pack, (2) try fullfp rot table to confirm quant table suspicion, (3) add assert + telemetry for slot mapping errors.

kai: if you need a quick review ping me; I can help with packing math and stride checks.

shreya: thanks - will update here with the `fullfp` result.
